title: Trailing sparklines on BigNumber (before/after placement)

complexity.rationale: The approach is fully known: add a placement prop and reorder the existing Flex children in BigNumber.tsx. All four orientation/position combinations reuse the same reordering pattern already present in the file (conditional Flex ordering keyed off `orientation`) — no site requires new, non-precedented logic.

summary: BigNumber's sparkline is always rendered ahead of the label/value block in packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/rc/components/BigNumber/BigNumber.tsx (the `{lineProps && <BigNumberChart .../>}` block is the first child in the outer Flex), which visually places it left of the number in horizontal orientation and above it in vertical orientation. This request adds a prop to also allow placing the sparkline after the number (right/below), useful when BigNumber is used as a chart header.
requirements: Add a new prop (e.g. `sparklinePosition`: 'before' | 'after') to BigNumberOptions/BigNumberProps, defaulting to 'before' to preserve current visual behavior for existing consumers.
When 'after' is set, render the BigNumberChart sparkline block after the icon/label/value Flex block in the outer Flex in BigNumber.tsx, instead of before it.

Combined with existing `orientation` ('horizontal' | 'vertical'), the four combinations must resolve as: before+horizontal = sparkline left, before+vertical = sparkline above, after+horizontal = sparkline right, after+vertical = sparkline below.
No change to spacing/columnGap or sizing logic (getBigNumberSize, getBigNumberChartDimensions) — only ordering changes.

edgeCases.case: sparklinePosition='after' combined with an icon prop
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Icon+label+value layout (the icon-and-lineProps branch inside the text Flex) is unaffected; only the outer sparkline-vs-text-block ordering changes.
Sparkline still renders within available space; no overlap with the value/label text.

edgeCases.case: sparklinePosition set but no sparkline children (Line) provided
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: No-op — nothing renders differently since `lineProps` is undefined and the BigNumberChart block is skipped entirely either way.
Before/after placement should be evaluated for whether it should flip in RTL, or intentionally stay LTR-anchored; flag for design review.

crossCutting.notes: Purely a React Flex-ordering change in react-spectrum-charts; no Vega signal/scale involved. BigNumber has no s2 implementation yet (see gh-703 for the same note), so there is nothing to parity-check in vega-spec-builder-s2/react-spectrum-charts-s2.

implementationPlan.change: Add `sparklinePosition?: 'before' | 'after'` to BigNumberOptions with JSDoc; add to BigNumberOptionsWithDefaults-equivalent if the codebase applies a runtime default at this layer.
Passes through automatically via Omit<BigNumberOptions, ...> since it's a plain value prop; no change needed unless review decides otherwise.
Destructure `sparklinePosition = 'before'` in BigNumberInternal; wrap the BigNumberChart block and the icon/label/value Flex block so BigNumberChart renders before or after based on the new prop.
Document the new prop and add a 'Sparkline after value' example.
Add a story for `sparklinePosition='after'` next to the existing sparkline stories.

openQuestions: Should this prop be named `sparklinePosition`, or align with a more general naming convention if other trailing-element features (e.g. gh-703's delta) also need before/after placement?
Does 'after' placement need to flip under RTL locales, or stay anchored to physical left/right regardless of text direction?
